goal: Dấu Việt Admin Web: Lesson Preview, Validation & Publishing — full admin workflow Open Lesson → Save Draft → Preview → Validate → Fix → Publish → Verify → Republish against real Spring Boot endpoints (POST /admin/lessons/{id}/preview, /validate, /publish, /admin/events/{id}/publish, GET /api/v1/lessons/{id}/content).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Event publish button on event editor — POST /admin/events/{id}/publish, confirm dialog, VN error 'Sự kiện lịch sử chưa được xuất bản' surfaced on lesson publish 422 with link to event page; hidden unless DRAFT.

Visual lesson preview at /lessons/[id]/preview via POST /admin/lessons/{id}/preview — renders learner-safe projection (NOT raw draftJson): answer keys (correctOptionIds, expectedOrder, requiredEvidenceIds, expectedHypothesis, answerKey…) never reach DOM.

Renderers for READ, VIEW_IMAGE, MULTIPLE_CHOICE, EVIDENCE_SELECT, MATCHING, DRAG_ORDER, HYPOTHESIS_CHOICE, REASONING_CONNECT, VERIFICATION, CER, REFLECTION_PROMPT; honest placeholder for unsupported types (EXPLORE_MAP) with type name + config JSON.

PublishReadiness summary renders structured Map<String,Object> (stageCount/activityCount/evidenceRefs/schemaVersion/errorCount/warningCount) — never '[object Object]'; blocking errors vs warnings separated; 'Đi tới chỉnh sửa' jump resolves error paths to stage/activity.

Publish flow: expectedRowVersion optimistic lock + confirm dialog + success panel shows real versionNo + publishedAt + lessonVersionId; 409 → reload prompt; 422 → detail error list incl. EVENT_NOT_PUBLISHED link; ARCHIVED → static block; double-click protected via isPending.
Republish: PUBLISHED lesson draft edits don't touch published snapshot; 'Xuất bản phiên bản mới' bumps versionNo (1→2 verified e2e).
Learner verify: GET /api/v1/lessons/{id}/content (no /admin) returns versionNo + lessonVersionId + stage count — proves published snapshot reachable as Flutter will call it.
Unsaved-draft UX: builder toolbar preview/publish links + banner state preview/validate use the last SAVED draft; PublishReadinessCard jump targets disabled while dirty.

Tests: vitest unit (readiness card Map summary, preview renderers no-key-leak, publish page 422/409/verify, event publish button) + Playwright journey (event publish → lesson preview → validate → publish → verify → republish v2; DRAFT-event blocking) vs controlled stub.
Gates green: tsc --noEmit, next lint, vitest 101/101, next build, playwright 13/13; no Flutter screens, no scoring, no version history UI, no auth refactor.

nextAction: TASK-0018 — Flutter learner screens: consume GET /api/v1/lessons/{id}/content + learner asset content; attempt/submission flow theo LEARNING_ENGINE_DESIGN (idempotent, pinned version); scoring engine backend-side. Smoke test publish journey vs real Spring Boot khi Docker/Postgres sẵn sàng.
